2607.27084.title: SciFigQual-Bench: A Benchmark for Scientific Figure Quality Assessment with Full-Manuscript Context
2607.27084.paper_summary: Scientific images are the core elements of presenting experimental conclusions, elaborating system architecture, and supporting comparative arguments in scientific papers. However, existing image quality assessment (IQA) methods are predominantly designed for natural photographs or AI-generated content, which cannot be directly applied to scientific papers. The few existing studies on scholarly charts remain confined to visual-surface comparisons, failing to verify caption alignment, citation relevance, or visual misleadingness. To address this, we propose SciFigQual-Bench, a full-text contextual benchmark that evaluates scientific images across five dimensions (clarity, layout, caption fit, context relevance, and misleading risk). The data covers top computer-science conferences from 2020 to 2025; 6,308 images were independently scored by multiple domain experts in five dimensions and aggregated into gold-standard annotations. Unlike previous scientific figure benchmarks, our dataset binds each image to its caption, citing sentence, and manuscript context. To enable automated evaluation on this benchmark, we designed a staged cross-modal evaluation framework SFQ-Agent to achieve auditable and refined scoring through the collection and fusion of modal evidence. Multiple mainstream large models were evaluated on the test subset eval1200, and SFQ-Agent (F3) equipped with GPT-5.6-Sol achieved the lowest overall average absolute error (0.418) and the highest consistency rate (93.4%), consistently outperforming both direct evaluation and auxiliary (Sidecar) visual language model evaluation schemes.
2607.27084.paper_summary_zh: 科學圖像是呈現實驗結論、闡述系統架構以及支持科學論文中比較論點的核心元素。<lb/>然而，現有的圖像質量評估（IQA）方法主要是為自然照片或人工智慧生成的內容設計的，無法直接應用於科學論文。<lb/>少數現有的學術圖表研究仍然局限於視覺表面比較，未能驗證標題對齊、引用相關性或視覺誤導性。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了SciFigQual-Bench，這是一個全文本上下文基準，評估科學圖像的五個維度（清晰度、佈局、標題適配、上下文相關性和誤導風險）。<lb/>數據涵蓋了2020年至2025年期間的頂尖計算機科學會議；6308幅圖像由多位領域專家在五個維度上獨立評分，並匯總成為金標準註釋。<lb/>與以往的科學圖形基準不同，我們的數據集將每幅圖像與其標題、引用句子和手稿上下文綁定在一起。<lb/>為了在這個基準上實現自動評估，我們設計了一個分階段的跨模態評估框架SFQ-Agent，以通過收集和融合模態證據來實現可審計和精煉的評分。<lb/>多個主流大型模型在測試子集eval1200上進行了評估，而配備GPT-5.6-Sol的SFQ-Agent（F3）達到了最低的整體平均絕對誤差（0.418）和最高的一致性率（93.4%），持續優於直接評估和輔助（Sidecar）視覺語言模型評估方案。
